verdict.rationale: Productboard's own marketing describes in-product AI insights: it automatically detects insights in feedback and suggests links to related feature ideas, surfaces feedback trends with citations for every finding, and includes a built-in agent that synthesizes information. Together these cover both insights and suggestions from the user's data inside the product. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the insight and suggestion features work, independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on suggestion types beyond feedback-to-feature linking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Productboard automatically detects insights within feedback that can be linked to related feature ideas.
Understand critical feedback trends and act fast on new opportunities. Productboard includes citations for every finding, so decisions are always backed by evidence.
Productboard's built-in agent handles all the information synthesis
